metadata.name: dsh-session-settings

paragraphs.text: Per-session settings infrastructure for DSH: a native right-sidebar settings page plus a host-side s
tore and HTTP bridge other plugins register their options into.
Per-session settings infrastructure for DeepSeek Harness.

- **Host half** owns the per-session configuration truth and exposes the `sessionSettings` service
(
register / get / set / reset / subscribe). Declarative items are registered from consumer host halve

s.
- **Browser half** registers one native right-sidebar tab (id and kind: `session-settings`) that

renders
every registered plugin's options for the session the tab belongs to.
- Overrides are stored

per session through the official storage domain
(`<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_settings/`); nothing
is written into session logs or the profile patch.
Status: 可用（宿主服务 + 浏览器页面 + 存储 + 桥接 + 界面）。依赖与升级对照见 docs/dsh-dependencies.md。
